Question
========
What does the Palma ratio compare?

Answerlist
----------
* The income share of the richest 10% with that of the poorest 40%
* The income share of the richest 1% with that of the poorest 50%
* Wealth with income
* The area between the Lorenz curve and the diagonal

Solution
========
The Palma ratio is the income share of the top 10% divided by the share of the bottom 40%. It focuses on the tails, where most differences between countries arise.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
